scenicChapters.title: Basque Coast Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 50 km this is Basque Coast Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

basque-coast-route.story: A one-way ride of 193 km, Bilbao to Donostia / San Sebastián - roughly 2 h 38 in the saddle. It goes by way of San Juan de Gaztelugatxe, Lekeitio and Zumaia. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 62 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.
